requirements.description: Synchronous reset clears the loop counters, accumulator, running and done
The engine stays idle until start is pulsed, then begins from (0,0,0)
Every C element equals the 32-bit wraparound GEMM of A and B with ReLU applied
done asserts after the N^3-cycle GEMM and stays asserted while halted
raw mode stores the wrapped sum without applying ReLU (negative results preserved)
A second GEMM run with fresh matrices produces correct ReLU results
Reset after a completed run clears the C memory and done
